messages.text:
I’m keeping the implementation bounded to the declared benchmark surface rather than trying to recreate interactive Nushell.

The key risk is output formatting, especially tables, so the port will implement both value semantics and Nushell-like display for common list/record/table outputs instead of only JSON-style printing.
